name: Hossein Salami
role: Iranian IRGC aerospace commander (2005–2009), deputy commander (2009–2019), and commander-in-chief (2019–2025)
summary: Salami defended Iran’s Islamic revolutionary state, repression of anti-government unrest, regional armed partners and sustained missile development. He repeatedly called for Israel’s elimination. His later public nuclear position rejected nuclear weapons while supporting diplomatic negotiations and conventional deterrence.
